assignment-intake.name: Assignment Intake
assignment-intake.description: Build an intake pack from the assignment sheet and the VIN file: claim, VIN, DOL, insurer, mileage if present.

authorization-missing.name: Authorization Missing
authorization-missing.description: Compare estimate or supplement dollars to portal screenshots or signed auth they saved.

customer-pay-vs-insurer.name: Customer Pay Vs Insurer
customer-pay-vs-insurer.description: Split estimate lines by the pay type they coded: insurer, deductible as posted, and customer-pay.

cycle-time-list.name: Cycle Time List
cycle-time-list.description: List stage dates from their cycle calendar joined to open estimates.

estimate-from-files.name: Estimate From Files
estimate-from-files.description: Build an estimate pack from their labor matrix, parts file, and estimate export.

oem-procedure-present.name: OEM Procedure Present
oem-procedure-present.description: Index procedure PDFs against estimate operations that their process says need a page.

parts-order-vs-estimate.name: Parts Order Vs Estimate
parts-order-vs-estimate.description: Join the parts PO sheet to estimate lines: part, qty, source, promised date, backorder.

photo-index.name: Photo Index
photo-index.description: Index the photo folder with their file names and required angles if they stored a shot list.

supplement-log.name: Supplement Log
supplement-log.description: List estimate versions from the supplement log and join to the estimate export so first-write versus later dollars stay visible.
